current_experience: Built a kit and can edit simple Arduino code.

sessions.student_message: What beginner project would help me explore mechanical engineering?
sessions.expected_behavior: Connect the project to robotics or engineering and the student's math/science strengths. Explicitly connect the response to Introduction to Engineering (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: I'm also curious about astronomy. Suggest a simple way to observe the Moon and record how it looks over a week.
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Treat astronomy as the current interest. Suggest one project, connect it to at least one applicable course per grade year when useful, and avoid framing it as the prior interest or changing the saved profile.

sessions.student_message: I have two 30-minute blocks this week. Help me plan a simple cardboard bridge experiment.
sessions.expected_behavior: Suggest two short blocks with a concrete bridge test. Explicitly connect the response to Geometry (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful.

sessions.student_message: I built the bridge and made one test, but I forgot to record how much it held. What should I change next week?

actions.text: Record the load from two trials

sessions.expected_behavior: Use the saved partial progress and recommend recording the load. Explicitly connect the response to Introduction to Engineering (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful.

sessions.student_message: What is one measurement I should record to make my next bridge test more useful?
sessions.expected_behavior: Apply a geometry concept to a measurable bridge-test variable. Explicitly connect the response to Geometry (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful. Carry forward a concrete relevant detail from the earlier cardboard bridge experiment discussion when it helps, and keep the intervening astronomy topic out of the answer.

sessions.student_message: How could I make a three-color poster to explain recycling?
sessions.expected_behavior: Address graphic design as the active interest and suggest a manageable starting project.

sessions.student_message: When I tried putting pennies at the center, the folded piece sagged before the flat one. What should I keep the same next time?
sessions.expected_behavior: Infer the earlier cardboard bridge load test. Keep span and load placement fixed, change only the design, and record the maximum load.

sessions.student_message: Help me compare a flat cardboard strip and a folded one fairly.
sessions.expected_behavior: Answer the new task while using relevant saved profile or earlier context.

follow_ups.student_message: Where exactly should the pennies go, and what should I write down for each trial?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Use the just-discussed setup and answer the detail without restarting the whole task.

follow_ups.student_message: How do I compare three load trials for the folded strip? Separately, what should I note when the Moon is behind clouds?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Carry the fair-test setup forward and separately explain how to mark an obscured Moon observation.

sessions.student_message: How could I explain my recycling poster in a one-minute talk?
sessions.expected_behavior: Return to the poster topic after bridge work and suggest a short talk structure.

sessions.student_message: The sky cleared for only a few minutes. Is one sketch enough for tonight?
sessions.expected_behavior: Infer the earlier Moon log and distinguish a brief observation from a missing one.

sessions.student_message: For my three-color poster, how can I make the headline readable from the doorway? Separately, should the next bridge test use exactly the same span?
sessions.expected_behavior: Retrieve the saved poster and bridge discussions across earlier sessions and answer both.
